adjusted_volatile_messages: Validate a channel list; no channels is a valid choice.
composition_summary: Offline-design mode. The instruction requests one class-22 pure-logic candidate (pc-check-channel-list) with name/description/content only, no host/Tool calls, no exceptions, and result={ok:boolean,channels:original list if valid else []}. This is a deterministic pure-logic component: it validates a channel list (integers 0..255, list or empty) and returns a success object or an empty list, never an exception. It makes zero host.<tool>(...) calls and assigns result on every defined outcome, satisfying the class-22 contract. Typed inputs are a target interface, not deployed runtime support, so this is an unapproved draft only. The requested invalid-result object (channels:[] when invalid) is preserved as data, not an exception. No provider capabilities were invoked; the packet is preserved exactly. No compatibility/intent/settings updates were requested, so those arrays remain empty.

payload.name: pc-check-channel-list
payload.description: Pure-logic validation of a channel list. Accepts a list (including an empty list) whose items are exact integers 0..255 inclusive; rejects bool, float, null, missing and wrong types. Returns {ok:boolean, channels:original list if valid else []}. No exceptions, imports, host calls or I/O.
